text: This is the best place in Chester County. Love the food, atmosphere and the service is awesome. Highly recommend and very family friendly.
Good typical Greek American dishes served in a large busy dining room.they seem to observe covid regulations although the dining room tends to get crowded.

I took a bite because I was starving. This was my first time coming here and I was a little disappointed because the menu looked so good and it was awesome how you can get French toast, pancakes, omelettes and many more options through a drive through. There was a couple cars in front of me and it did not go by fast. Each car took a good 7 minutes at the register. When it was my turn to pay my order was wrong. I said I wanted a sausage egg and cheese on a sesame bagel but they said that I said I was sausage egg and cheese on a english muffin. Whatever they quickly made it to a sesame bagel and I was pretty relaxed with how long it took. I was disappointed with what I got. The bagel was very tough you couldn't even tell it was toasted. But one thing I liked is that they use a real egg not the fake premade eggs most drive through use. I wonder if they didn't do a great job on my sandwich because they took my order wrong so they quickly remade it? I decided that I will go back to try again and then I'll have my opinion on this place.

Literally some of the best tacos I've ever had. I'm sad I tried this at the end of the trip because now I can't get more. The pico (pineapple and regular) is fantastic. I had the vegetarian taco and the chicken street taco. They were both good and it came with chips. The kids meals were a little pricey, but they came with a drink, fries, and fruit or a cookie. Our server, Chris, was so nice and helpful. He was always there when we needed something. I do wish the overall meal was a little cheaper, but it's a tourist town so it is what it is.

This place has really gone downhill. I used to really like it, because it was affordable and there were many topping options. The place also seemed pretty clean. But now it appears they have gotten rid of most of the workers, so getting a pizza is now almost impossible. This evening we ordered a pizza online, and drove to pick it up.  Two hours later the pizza still hasn't been put in the oven.  
Really just a miserable experience.
Amazing lunch!  I had the beet salad -best I ever had.  Chicken sandwich very good and chorizo frittata was good.  Such a nice view outside and relaxing music -worth giving a try!
I only go to the Honeysuckle for Austin!  Who's the best bartender, best server in all of Franklin restaurants! He always makes us feel welcome and goes above and beyond.

I WAS a frequent eater at properly fueled mainly due to my gluten sensitivities and allergies. Those of you who know me even recommended this place even posts on Facebook. I will no longer dine here not because of the food, but because of the way the handled a miscommunication between myself and staff. As I approached the register I asked for some gluten free bread with hummus. The lady behind the register said "you mean a hummus sandwich" and I said with hesitation yes I guess... can I just have some avocado with it. As they do have avocado smash as well as an order of hummus. She saw I didn't look at the menu. When the order came out it was a full sandwich with tomatoes carrots onions etc. I have an allergy to carrots and was not expecting a full sandwich more like hummus and avocado on gluten free bread.  What proceeded next for someone who frequents the there was sooooo ludicrous. The lady behind the register said that I would have to pay for
another sandwich. I asked to speak with the owner since she knows me and I'm there a lot. Her daughter came out who also knew me as we had discussions before didn't even say hello,
And said you knew it was on the menu and proceeded to argue with me. I said it was a misunderstanding but I shouldn't have to pay and she insisted. She even put words in my mouth saying "since you are saying it's her fault" which I never said it was the staffs fault, it was a misunderstanding. What a shame they would treat a regular customer like that. Bec
The Stillery has Amazing pizza! We got the "Meats" rustic pie and the Mac & Cheese with Hot Chicken for a sample of Nashville. Note the Hot Chicken prepare for heartburn:) HOT!!!
Ever since the remodel, this location has been awesome. I hope they are able to reopen after the covid19 crisis

This may have been my favorite place in Indie I had to go a second time before returning home.  The drinks were amazing the bartenders friendly and super hipster,  like when they started crushing ice with a mallet in a cloth sack I almost lost my shit! 
Their beet salad, hold the cheese, was one of the most delicious salads I have ever had - seriously!  I made my friend taste it and this is a person that is afraid of veggies and he even loved it. The house chips were super good and oddly enough paired with little of the salt foam they served with the oysters.  The Brussels were not may favorite, not bad but I prefer them to be crispy and these were soggy with too much balsamic.  The cocktails were amazing The Bees Knees and Bryans Song were among favorites. 

I would totally recommend spending time here and enjoying a cocktail and a meal.

Greatest pork chop in the history of pork 
Great apps
Drinks watered down maybe?
Service great 
Brisket great 
Crab cakes great
We love this place, and go there frequently. Their lunch special on weekdays is awesome. Best deal in town. Love the drunken noodles!

Cake Bake is one of my favorite places in Indianapolis. You can't go wrong with a single desert on the menu. They have something for almost everyone with a sweet tooth. 

The chocolate cake that they're famous for is worth the hype! The brownies and chocolate chip cookies are mouth watering. The cheese cake and peanut buttermoose cake will put you in a food coma.

I always get my items to-go, but if you want to sit down -- call ahead! The wait time can be over an hour.

Golf Indy has a Korean BBQ place like this!
My first time there and it really reminded me of the time when I visited South Korea and had BBQ there. 
I definitely recommend doing all you can eat. First round they bring you a platter of several kind, and  after you are done with that you will order meat of your choice. How fun. 
Server came back several times not to just take orders but also put meat on the grill. They changed the grill once for us. Service was great. 
Tips: it's very smoky inside so please know that your hair and clothes will definitely smell like BBQ  after that! 
I put 4 reviews because I don't think social distancing was strictly enforced , automatic 20% tip (it's understandable for all you can eat BBQ but what if you just order a dish from the menu, or didn't receive the best service?) , and  only two kinds of sauce provided for BBQ. 
I'll definitely go back.

This place is a BIG case of not judging a book by its cover! Tucked between a shell gas station & a liquid store, you wouldn't imagine you'd find the best pizza and wings on the Westside here - but it's true! The staff is always friendly and ready to welcome anyone in to dine. It also helps that every time we go it seems to be the same folks - which just gives it that extra comfort feeling for the regular diners. The wings are huge & not like your typical flats found at other places. Like a lot of toppings? They have you covered! I recommend trying my personal favorite - the Meaty. If you need to feed a small army, make sure you call ahead and order the Big Panoony {would also cause quite the sensation at a birthday party!}. Fast service, good food, kind people, what more could you want?

Probably my favorite place to have business breakfasts or lunches during the week, and hang out with my girls for brunch on the weekends. I only wish they were open for dinner! The food is really good, flavor profiles are quite tasty and they do a lot to accommodate my gluten allergy. If you have not tried it, I highly recommend you do!

Really get some local Philly vibes from this spot - always bustling with customers, solid music playing in the background, loud and exciting space.

They have a good menu - unique veggie options, vast beer selection. Mainly bar food, but prepared & presented a bit more upscale. You gotta try their burger or chicken pot pie - they feel like their staples. I also would suggest the ricotta balls and the chili sweet potatoes - definite standouts.  

Parking is really tough in the part of the northern liberty neighborhood, so be prepared to spend some time there or just try to get their via lyft/uber.
Great service. They were closing soon but allowed us to at least order our food. Food and entertainment were really good.

Went last Friday night with my friend and her parents. Apparently Friday night is wine flight night, so we definitely took advantage of that! Everything was absolutely delicious. Our waitress was a like corky but I just think she was new. You definitely need a reservation. Note that the entrees don't come with a side, so you can rack up a bill pretty easily there. Ambience was fun and up scale. We sat under a speaker in a corner and the waitress noticed it was a bit loud and turned it down for us. At the end of the meal I asked to see a gluten free menu to see if this is a place I could bring my sister when she comes to visit town. Not did the waitress bring me a menu to keep, but she highlighted things that could be substituted to make the meal gluten free. Very impressed.

This is a good local spot for food and coffee. Sometimes the service takes a while, but it is usually quick. The food is tasty and the counter girls are very sweet. I enjoy the salads, sandwiches, and the breakfast options here. I also really like when they have the Bavarian chocolate iced coffee. I've gone here for several years and will continue to go back in the future.
Outstanding food (especially the trout and the panna cotta). The service was warm, efficient, and accommodating. And their wine list is amazing. I would eat there every night if I could.

We had great first experience and wanted try it again. So I made reservation via open table and even though it was weekend there wasn't many people walking around Nashville with Covid-19 still around. I was pleased people on the street even pan handlers had masks. We arrived early and were seated immediately. Service was good, ordered same items as our pre Covid-19 visit and tasted just as great. So still highly recommend Bakersfield. Support your local businesses!!

Read the Inquirer's review and booked Gabi for Valentines Day. We took early reservations and everything was perfect. They called prior to let us know there was a special menu. Great customer care. Parking was easy and inexpensive. Our waitress was helpful and attentive. The food was marvelous. We started with the cheese plate and the pate'. Very flavorful. Then the Duck Confit and the Steak were perfectly cooked and seasoned. Dessert of creme brûlée and chocolate mousse were the perfect finishes to a spectacular night.

Thai tea is BOMB. Wife had drunken noodles which were really good. I had pad thai with chicken and shrimp which was good. We tried the moo ping which is like a barbecue pork which was on point as well. Thai tea though...

Normally I have a great experience here but not so much today. Used the drive thru today to order my family's food. Long wait and then I received our food. It's a busy parking lot and the bag was quite packed so I didn't take everything out to inspect, nor should I have to. 

When we arrived home, the hotdog of one of our kid's meals was not there. It's hard to explain to a 3 year old that his food is not there while everyone else's is. So we prepared him something else and also,  a 10 min drive is not worth it for a $2 hotdog.

What happened to this place?? I suspect it is new ownership. The food was horrible! Small portions, over cooked and dry. Waitress was nice, but had no clue about drinks or menu items when questions were asked. I'm sad because I used to love going to this place.  Sorry, I won't be going back.. and also the bathrooms were filthy

Updating to 5 stars! This place just keeps getting better. I've tried just about everything on their menu now (been going here for about 8 years) and have yet to be disappointed. 
My favorites: 
Shrimp satay
Crying tiger
Crying fish
Smile calamari 
Princess dumplings 
Thai tea

Wow!  A once upon a time family favorite. My dad and I would eat here at least twice a week. Not anymore unfortunately. I miss those days before Marnell Gaming owned the Nugget. Named after his late wife Rose Ascauga, John Ascauga took pride in his restraint. Marnell does not. The food is substandard and terrible. The menu is extremely limited. The wonderful daily pastries are gone. The staff with the exception of a few, are extremely rude. Gone is amazing restaurant experience at the Nugget. It is no more.  Don't waste your money. In fact Marnell's Nugget is just awful wherever you go.

I casually visited Pana with my sister a few weeks ago. I had a cronut,  glazed chocolate donut, and a Peach Boba Tea. My sister had a hot coffee and a two chocolate donuts. The donuts were delicious, the beverages were fresh and delightful. I hope to visit again soon.
This is our second visit today, it's lovely, food is great, and the service is amazing, I promise this place will be my only place to eat every time We're in Reno

I'd heard a lot about the Blue Owl Restaurant & Bakery from DDD with Guy Fieri. I've actually gone to a few of the restaurants that he recommended and I'm sad to say, they weren't as great as the hype. Blue Owl, sadly falls short as well. I went with two family members on a Saturday for lunch. Two of us ordered the special-chicken fried steak and the third member of our party ordered a Rueben on wheat. The gravy that had a very distinct bacon flavor was kind of greasy. The mash potatoes were from scratch-they were very good. We both had the spinach and cheese casserole which disappointed as well. It pretty much just tasted of spinach and that was all. Two of us ordered dessert. I had the levy high apple pie (caramel and pecan topping) and my other guest has the chocolate cake. My guest said the cake was very good, but he'd had better. What can I say about the apple pie? Baking a pie that large is going to be problematic. The apples, though uniformly thin sliced, were still crisp. The spice mix and sugar ration was good--not overly sweet. The top crust was done perfectly but the bottom crust was a little soggy. Their biscuits are huge, but really chewy and you can taste the baking soda in them.I'm sorry, though the food is good, it's certainly not worth the 30-45 minute wait for a table in a restaurant so crowded that you'd better introduce yourself to the people at the next table. You'd be much happier if you went down the street to Smokee Robinson's Cajun Smokehouse for ribs
Food is great and fresh.  Great sushi variety.  Wonton soup has great flavor.   All food is excellent.

Great food, great service. Sat at the chefs counter. Started with toast and the swordfish tartare. Crab cracker and dumplings were great. Venison and halibut perfect but the duck was outrageously good. For dessert cheese, chocolate mousse and Varro pudding. Great dinner and super affordable

Looking for something to do on a rainy Thursday yesterday we drove to the sleepy little town of Medford specifically to try this highly touted Italian restaurant. Although very good in all facets of their operation it just lacked what it takes to earn that fifth star.  So, our 100 mile round trip jaunt was not in vain but don't think we would do it again any time soon. 

The food all very good can be seen in my attached photos. Bottom line:  if you are in the area or live near by, then by all means give them a try.

First off- not staying here.  Just for an event.  The bar in the lobby, the drinks were good. However, they didn't know their own menu, they didn't know what went in the drinks, they didn't make the drink as presented in the menu, and the menu had wrong prices- it was $3.50 more than in the menu.  I'm OK with everything EXCEPT presented expectations being different from what was actually delivered.  Fix your menu and your bartenders and then 5 stars.  The drink was good.

Yum! Small plates are my favorite way to eat and for a vegetarian, this place was just great! We got a bunch of veggie options to share and all the flavors were excellent. The service and unique cocktails were wonderful as well! Highly recommend.
Great food. The ravioli seemed more fresh than the pasta. We had spaghetti carbonara, which tasted good, but the noodles were too soft. The Pesto Ravioli tasted fresh and yummy.
The chocolate choquette is  a must have. Highly recommended! Also had the butter and ham sandwich. The baguette is of high quality!
Gross!!!!! Low quality food....first and last time there! Would definitely not recommend

I've only had two donuts from this establishment so I don't know if I qualify for this review but I am going to give it a shot. 

If you are looking for a yeast, doughy donut, this isn't for you. The ones here are basically a piece of cake disguised as a donut. I'm so serious. It's so yum! There are so many flavors to choose from. The employees are so smiley and happy to assist. They are proud of what they do and their product. You can see that in the way they serve you.

Best Mexican food on the east side take my word for it. As many know food options on the east side of town stink especially good Mexican, however Salsa Verde proves to be a quite a delicious option in this food desert. Everything is delicious, my favorite is the gorditas with pok pibil, though the burritos are awesome too. The crazy is thing is this place has been here awhile and for some reason I never went because I didn't think it would be good. I'm glad I gave it a shot.

Ordered takeout from here which included butter chicken, chicken biryani and an order of just the tikka Masala sauce. Located in a gas station, the kitchen area is clean and hygienic with an open view for customers. The food itself was extremely flavorful with the butter chicken being top notch. Will definitely be back to satisfy my butter chicken cravings.

Imagine it's 10pm on a weeknight and you and your significant other look at each other and realize you're starving but you are also really lazy! Yes, that means take out but it's late. Pizza! All of your usual pizza places are closed but alas, pizza is stoner/late night food, so there has to be a pizza joint open! 
Found it!!! Always open New York New York Pizza! 

I'm going to admit that I wasn't sure about what I'd get and I can be a bit snobby about my pizza because o font eat it a lot , so I want it to be good! Well, I was pleasantly surprised by this pizza. We have now gotten the XL supreme to-go twice since discovering this late night and very reasonably priced pizza joint. The XL supreme is only $18.99 which is a good price for an XL filled with toppings. We may explore more unique selections at some point but we really enjoyed the supreme. 

They also have a large menu with many options besides pizza, so I'd you are looking for a late night (or anytime) meal, there's a whole bunch to choose from. I highly recommend adding the garlic knots as an appetizer. They are delicious but you are going to want to wear a mask and social distance just because of the garlic you will be consuming. I don't even like garlic and I like these knots! You get 12 of them for $4.99... what?! Such a great price. You can get 6 for $3.99 or 24 for $8.99. 

Here's what I've learned from my 2 visits. If you want your crust a little doughier to roll up, get the thinner crust at regular bake. I le

Cake! Cake! Cake! I think about it often and when I do Village bakehouse is the first place i want to go to satisfy my cake craving! Their cakes are always dense and moist, perfectly balanced flavors hit your palate and play a musical melody!! A true sign (to me) of stellar desserts are those that are not overly sweet, and bakehouse has this perfected! I've had their pink champagne with buttercream frosting and every bite was sheer delight. One year I ordered chocolate cake with peanut butter filling - a childhood fantasy come true! I am hooked. I tell anyone and everyone who will listen to me talk about how amazing Bakehouse's cakes are! I have had their other sweets and pastries as well and they too are amazing. Their breakfast and lunch menu is amazing and such a nice touch for a bakery! If you have deprived yourself of amazing cake you should feel ashamed and quickly remedy it with VILLAGE BAKEHOUSE CAKE!!

I grew up eating at Wright's pretty frequently but Its been a while since I have been to here because  the last couple times were nothing to write home about. This visit was so much better! The sandwich was as even better than I remember! The service was quick and friendly, the restaurant is extremely clean, with team members constantly wiping surfaces and cleaning, while checking on and assisting customers.
So glad I stopped in!!!
This place is very friendly and set to make sure you have a good experience. The food is absolutely amazing. Highly recommend the Mac and cheese bites. Would definitely go here again in the future.
Red Robin has really turned things around. They used to be slow all the time, but for the past year or so they've been great! Updating my former 1-star review.

Came during pandemic times for outdoor dining in the fall. They have a nice setup with a wooden outdoor tent that blocks out some of the wind.

We shared a few apps and pizzas, and their pizza is one of my FAVORITES. If you like neopolitan style like I do, then their chewy, bubbly crust is perfect. The toppings are also wonderful - the Leslie chow and frank white are my favorites, the spicy jawn is a little too pepperoni/meat heavy for my liking. But honestly you can't go wrong.

I hadn't thought much about WM before, but after returning to it, I realize how much of a gem it is. I'll definitely be back.

I ordered chicken udon noodles and they put in like 4 measly strips of dry bland chicken - not at all worth the 14$ I paid. Also ordered the $7.00 4 piece steamed pork dumplings which ended up being a literal 4 bites - each one was barley a mouth full.

I think that this place tasted just fine but it was way over priced and they didn't really have that many topping options. As someone who goes to these kind of places and enjoys sushi at least twice a week I have a pretty good idea of how these things should be priced compared to what you're getting in it. I paid $15-16 for a very small container and that's of toppings the would be included at other places were and extra cost or had to be purchased as a side. Nothing about this place impressed me. when I'm in downtown spend this much money I'd like to be a little more impressed.

Love that this is all gluten free, but they need to step up their sandwich game. I could hear and see each part of my French dip sandwich being microwaved and the bread ended up undercooked and mushy. Being a from scratch bakery, it would be nice if sandwiches were prepared fresh and not microwaved.

Refreshing fruit bowls with jelly, slushee, and mango flavored ice cream had my mom ordering 2! She couldn't get enough. My mom has very specific tastes when it comes to desserts and this one hit the spot! Light and tart fruit bowls after Philly cheesesteaks was what the night called for!

The mango pancake is good too though not a pancake by typical means. It is whipped coconut cream with mango chunks which are wrapped in a yellow crepe blanket and made to look like a cube! Interesting but a bit pricey for whipped cream and fruit. 

The waitress was nice too and was prompt with service. She was very timid in her demeanor but very friendly. 

Worth a visit!
Go for the customer service and the coffee is a bonus. Wasn't the best cup of joe I've had but certainly better than Starbucks! Go local in Boise

Seriously, B+D?! What sloppy mess is this? Quickly grabbed lunch in between meetings only to find this mess. I don't have time to go back. Friendly reminder, check your carry out back before leaving. Def not good B+D!

If only there was a 0 star.... such rude people behind that counter. I will never ever come back to this place. The man behind the counter I'm sure was the owner and I just can't believe this place is still open

So I will preface my review by saying that the waitress was so nice and attentive and did a great job. However this was the worst meal I've had in Nashville and I've lived here my whole life. 

I got the truffle Mac and cheese with buttermilk fried chicken. Absolutely no hint of truffle on it and the cheese sauce was marginal. The chicken was the real travesty. Buttermilk fried chicken is flaky and moist, their chicken was sad little strips in some kind of breadcrumb mixture fried to death. 

My husband got the gumbo with a king crab leg add on. The gumbo sauce was good, but they seemed to have put a bunch of tiny frozen shrimp in it. Not only that but the king crab leg was NOT king crab. It was snow crab which is extremely different and way cheaper. They charged $18 for that one piece of crab.

Their prices are highway robbery for what comes out of the kitchen. The only good thing was the oysters because they weren't cooked. I really do not understand how the owners thought they could get away with putting something like this in 12th south. 

Looking forward to what goes into the space next.
Awesome food  and cool ambiance!!  Loved the yogurt with granola and avocado hummus toast!!

Bear with me because it's really hard to type this as I teeter on the brink of a food coma. To start the wait was about 40 minutes but what makes it worth it is they don't cook your food until they're ready so even if you wait that long when it hits a table it's fresh.

We had the steelhead pizza, 2 lbs of wings, and the frachos. Sweet Jesus I can barely stand the smell of my breath, the garlic and spices are so rich. If garlic is truly good for your health this meal added 10 years to my life. Subtract the five that the frachos took from me and I'm still ahead.. 

This place is absolutely delicious and worth whatever the wait is. Get yourself a round of drinks, enjoy a nice conversation, I wait for the food at hit the table cuz that's when the show starts.

Service was outstanding, servers were very personable, and God bless the bartender... He rescued me when I thought I was dying from garlic toxification.

We were so looking forward to eating at the Reading Terminal Market during our stay in Philadelphia. I'd read great things about the food at Hershel's East Side Deli. Unfortunately, my husband and I did not find this to be the case. We both ordered a grilled pastrami sandwich with cheese, sauerkraut and Russian dressing on rye bread. The meat was so overcooked that we had to remove large chunks of dry meat from the sandwich. The cheese was almost nonexistent and there was only a tiny dab of dressing on the entire sandwich -- all of which left the sandwich dry, dry, dry. We were able to choke most of it down with the help of a large drink. This was not the delicious experience that we were hoping to have at Hershel's.

Aight, ready. 
Idk why I've never had local taco before. Periodt! I had the spicy shrimp (drooling just thinking about it) and the hot chicken (isn't as good as reviews say/ def. totally average). The Mexican corn is ... margs were also great, though not the best I've had! Currently indoor and outdoor seating available, spacing is enforced. But the ambiance is . I really like this place!

This is a go to for me for lunch.  Pho chicken is fantastic as is their Thai basil rice.  Haven't heard of anyone not throughly enjoying their food.  Tucked in a dilapidated strip mall but cute and warm inside.  Highly recommend!

Disappointing and disjointed.  Really hard to recommend this place even though the food was excellent. The service simply fell apart. Had the kids and all seemed to start well when their orders were taken first.  Went off the rails when our entrees came out, before our appetizers and before the kids meals which were ordered before everything.  Asked where the kids meals were and everyone appeared attentive.  Then 7 or 8 minutes later we were told 1 minute, and the another person told us it was because meat takes longer to cook than fish.  And then, after the food came, nobody checked on us.  By the end, I couldn't wait to get out of the restaurant even though the food was excellent.
I had the London broil shawarma it was great. Reasonable prices and great customer service. Food was ready quickly and was really fresh. I highly recommend this place.

This restaurant, staff and food are excellent. The food is always cooked perfectly and the service is always excellent! Very tasty bbq ! Also, excellent tribute to military service members and first responders.
Terrific place with wood burning oven for delicious pizzas. Charred thin crust was scrumptious with yummy toppings! We would love one in St. Pete!

I tried this place for the first time and I didn't really enjoy my New Year's eve lunch, unfortunately. I don't know if it was just a bad day, but my falafel balls were burnt and had no flavor. The breaded flounder tasted like a frozen fish stick. I heard that they do have good food options, you just have to order the right dish (apparently I didn't). However, I did enjoy the eggplant dish.
Good chicken  well fried.  good drinks i love the place   Many location all food was consistently well made and tasty throughout all locations.  Will come back again on my next vacation

Looking for sandwich? This place has a ton of em. Beef,pork, chicken, turkey, vegan, hell they even have a part of the menu dedicated to all beef dogs with a variety of styles. House made chips, soups and chili. Price is decent and they are pretty quick.

First and last time ordering from here. I have had ceviche from multiple Mexican restaurants, it has never been uncooked shrimp. This is horrible. When we called about our order they told us they only give us cooked shrimp if we ask for it. WHAT?? Who would want uncooked shrimp in their ceviche!

Came in on a Saturday night a couple hours before closing and no other customers were there, received very poor service. Staff had their own drama going on while we were waiting and the waiter was super rushed. Ordered food togo instead in an effort to leave asap. Food was subpar. 

Will not be recommending.

We came on a Monday night and the place was slow so we were seated quickly. The waitress was attentive and explained the menu to us. I have a garlic allergy and she went to the kitchen and found out what items I could and could not have. The appetizers were delicious and then I ordered the grilled pork and it was done really well. They have a nice selection of bourbons and various cocktails. My only con was that they said they were out of a quite few of the items on their menu. One of the guys I was with had to give 3 different things on the menu to see if they had them. The waitress apologized as their truck had not arrived yet. All in all it was a great atmosphere and the food was good. I would definitely go back.

Love this place! Steaks are great, good prices, and it's one of the only places I trust to cook my steak extra rare and not the medium-medium rare you'll get everywhere else. Beer on tap is good, a little pricey for what you get, but those frozen margaritas are a bargain. $6 and some change for a margarita that will give you brain freeze and make you shiver before you're even halfway through the thing. They're huge! As for appetizers you really can't go wrong, but you can go right and order that onion blossom thingamajig and those rattlesnake bites, sheesh. And those rolls! With the cinnamon butter. With the whole coronavirus going on, I've been ordering some takeout lately (same amazing quality, by the way) and they gave me 7 of them!!! I'm only one gal. I said dang, had to share them with people! Not enough butter though. (But is there ever?)

Oh, and pro-tip - if they ever ask you if you want to upgrade your chili cup to a bowl for $1.... something, say yes.)

Home of the 25 minute drive thru.
Been to a lot of Popeyes but this one takes the cake on the slowest. If you have to be somewhere on time this location might not be for you or plan ahead

Always get the spicy when I go. But since they have closed the all drive thru and opened the dine in on overland things have really gone to hell. If you go there later than 7 or so you get luke warm meat and usually very dried out ie old stuff. If you go at lunch I hope you have an hour because the drive thru is slow slow slow. Today I pulled in, 4 cars ahead of me. 17 minutes later still 1 car ahead of me. I pulled out and left as I don't have an hour for lunch. Maybe put in an intercom so people in line could get their orders in instead of ordering at the window and waiting and waiting and waiting. Better yet, open the Drive thru spot back up! Problem solved.

We love Sabrina's. Food is delicious. I love the quality of the ingredients they use, President always seems so fresh and everything is so flavorful. The real reason we keep going back, though, is the amazing staff. R we headed 2 small children, and they have always made us feel so welcome. They are so sweet to the kids, abs even tolerate their occasional disasters. Truly one of our favorite spots.

Talk about a fun and delish sushi restaurant. The customer service is impeccable; it's always so personable, and you can't beat the price. I've ordered food here many a time, and I can't help but come back for more. And also the Robot arm to pass your takeout order is just too cute (Wait til the end, it bows).

While in the Tampa Area I was craving any type of Latin food. I found Nilsa's bistro. The outside has murals on the building. The inside has different pictures of Puerto Rico and a beautiful chalk mural.

I enjoyed the tostones, that were warm and hot! I also had the fried pork and yellow rice. The fried pork was cut in cubes. I also enjoyed one of their sandwiches and it was very meaty. 

Service was helpful.

you must go to this place. it is amazing! food is off the charts. staff is amazing! words can't even give this place credit til you eat there.
tuesday is half off pizza! no brainer

We left without eating...dirty tables everywhere but we were told they were clean--LIE! The paper menus were extremely dirty, used over and over again without being sanitized properly. And to top it off the waitress was SOoo rude!!! When we asked her to clean the table again she laid into us refusing to do it. We left never to return!!

Also posted on Google:
I dined at Roberts Block on a Friday evening ahead of restaurants and other dining establishments being closed down for in house dining due to the COVID-19 pandemic and enjoyed this visit. Our server was very bubbly and personable. Our drinks and food came out in a timely manner.

The Block Fries and Cheesesteak Dip were delicious. I opted for the shrimp tacos for my entree and my dinner companion opted for the short ribs and enjoyed them both. I look forward to trying other items on the menu including the Old Fashioned cocktail that got me started. Yum!

The best Neapolitan Pizza I've ever eaten. Everything is home made and the Caesar Salad was very good. I highly recommend this place. It's some the best pizza and service I've ever experienced. Will be back.
I come here all the time for lunch, and it's great. Some of their soups are misses but most are hits. Get here early for the lobster bisque, there's usually a long line out the door.

Awesome pizza and excellent crew working there.
You can order online or call in.. we have done both and both times, excellent experiences.

Definitely a great pizza place for our area..

Additionally, we have eaten in and they have a great selections of food, all extremely tasty, vegetarian options as well as carnivore options.

Their garlic knots that corms with their entrees are out of this world!! Their pasta dishes are also very good.. love the sauce and pasta is not overcooked!

Their calzone- huge!!! We got a single as well as large and large is big enough for 3-4 people.

Great local place, highly recommend folks to try this place!

This iHop is near a Perkins and down the street from a Bob Evans. All three restaurants are good for breakfast, but iHop is best for pancakes. iHop serves good bacon and eggs, too, but their grits are a little too dense for me, and my English muffin was difficult to cut. The staff is friendly and usually efficient. It was busy on a recent rainy Saturday morning, so our water glasses didn't get refilled during our visit. Our waitress did take our bill & cash, so that we could leave quickly. On the way out, we noticed a large group in a separate dining area to the right of the entrance. This is a good place for groups to meet and eat.

The owner is awesome!

Had a small issue and he fixed right away supper efficient!!!

Great place
Just walking the block on Barone and noticed this lovely restaurant so we came in...best cocktails and food is phenomenal our first stop for the night.

This place is just like most of the other spots on the beach, nothing special. Do not recommend eating here- save your money and appetite for something better but drink specials and happy hour is always worth a look.

Won't be going back! Bought tickets for a venue with two other couples week's ago we got to ironwood early to grab some food before show after finally getting drinks the show started one of our party asked a server walking by if we can get someone sent over to order the server responded "if the Service isn't fast enough you can walk up to the bar yourself otherwise good luck we are busy" at this point one of our group asked for a manager. The servers response was "I am the manager we are busy you are waisting your own time!" Then walked away... 
Believe it or not wasn't the  worst part of the night!!

At this point we showed our stamps to guy at the door went outside to discuss whether we were going to stay decided the girls are having an OK time we'll just stay and eat after.
Upon re entry one of the guys I was with walked to restroom and the door guy starts getting in my face asking "does your friend have an issue?!"
I responded "he has to Pee is all as far as I know!"
Door guy" he needs to show me his stamp and do u have a problem " standing in my face now!
My response was "I have an issue with poor service! Also if u approached my friend as  aggressively as u just approached me seems to me u are the one starting an issue! I would like to speak to a manager"! 
At this point the gentleman in the restroom exits and immediately the door guy is two inches from his face "u need to show me ur stamp on ur hand"! 
Gentlemen "I showed u on the way outside I just came back in" 
Door

This is my favorite restaurant in Phoenixville and it never disappoints! Everything is delicious! We've gotten take out several times now with COVID. I love their bread with hummus/olive oil. Their Caesar salad is always on point. Their pasta and fish are to die for. This is the only Italian restaurant that my husband will eat at!

2 years ago , I would've given this 4 stars really good. Now it's absolutely a different taste. First off the ramen was cold, maybe lukewarm  at best. Second, these noodles legit are 30% better than a decent instant ramen noodle. Third, for the price you're better off just getting instant ramen cuz idk who can be full of this tiny serving for 15$ and I'm 4'11. ( they only give you half an egg ) Did I mention it was cold? Like bro the meat was cold. I get the egg and maybe the broth but also the meat? Y'all didn't even bother to put the meat in the microwave?. Ps the Kuro ramen (most expensive) is just the oil from Mama noodles???And the flavor of the broth? Just salty I guess not rich or anything standing out at all.

Great selection of food and seemingly well prepared. The flavor profiles are all a little main stream and muted as not to be too strong. The drinks are good, but they seem to mix fresh ingredients with heavily processed additive drinks/liqours. All in all this is a good place to have a decent meal. I had the calamari and it was heavily breaded and salty. No fresh lemon but three different sauces. Pasta was good. Muscles were good. But not remarkable.

How have I never reviewed this place!? I go here once a week. The staff is absolutely fantastic, the food incredible, an extensive tap list, and they frequently have live music. The mac and cheese is phenomenal,  as is every sandwich I've had. My go tos are the tower of classics, the manchester melt, the Mississippi night club, the danimal, and the Murph. You really cant go wrong though with anything you order though. Oh, and they are open til 3a which is awesome. This place is why im fat.

We discovered this place less than a week ago and are on visit number 4. Our first visit was on a Friday that also happened to be a big graduation weekend--they got us in no problem when we called. They were packed, so we were waiting a bit for our chef to come cook our food, but they made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed on top of being apologetic about the wait. The atmosphere was so great that we didn't care! Our two subsequent visits included different family members that we wanted to introduce to this place! Everyone enjoyed the atmosphere and agreed the staff are great! The hibachi and sushi are good--not incredible, but it's definitely a great place to go for fun night out (sushi is a GREAT deal at half price all day)! Now we're on our 4th (and probably final--for now) visit until baby is due in a few days! 

Have to love a family owned restaurant that welcomes you with open arms even though you're those crazy people that go back 3 days in a row and then again for a 4th time less than a week later!
We ordered the Tuna Tartare, Carpaccio of Beef, and the Falls Off The Bone beef ribs.  Everything was super delicious and flavorful!  It's a must to dine here when you're in New Orleans!

I'm into all kinds of music but I really like traditional country music. I moved to Nashville from NYC a little over a year ago and made the rounds looking for a bar that had decent food, a good booze selection and good music (without being a dump full of townies, bros, and drunk bachelorettes)... So that pretty much rules out any place on Lower Broadway... I find the staff at The Local to be attentive and polite, (I don't know, maybe because I'm polite to them?)... Maybe there's a difference in the patrons on different nights, so I can only vouch for the vibe on nights where they feature classic honky tonk music, usually Friday, Saturday and Sunday. On those nights The Local attracts a nice mix of regulars and some out of towners of all ages. The sound guy is great and you will be hearing world class musicians do their thing (it is Nashville, after all)... I'm not young anymore, but I quickly discovered a local scene of mostly young people who are devoted to keeping the look, sound and spirit of traditional country music alive. The crowd on these nights is really great... some older Nashville folks, some tourists, and young people all tatted up and pierced, in vintage western wear all dancing and having fun together. Good country music and good country folks! ... it's quite endearing actually... I only drink bourbon and beer and the selection is good on those... I haven't tried everything on the menu but so far what I have ordered has far been superior to run of the mill bar
Great consistent restaurants , never had a bad experience.  The pizzas are good but the sandwiches are my favorites.  The Uptowner is my favorite.

This has to be the worst bbq in Tampa.   
The food is Not good.  
I threw my meal in the trash after one bite.  
I went to McDonald's which I don't like but I could actually eat what they offered. 
I wouldn't feed my dog from the deviled pig

Another visit to Tampa and I decide to try going outside of my zone which is near the Seminole Hard Rock Adventure more toward downtown Tampa. I chose this restaurant over Due Amici because the price or what appears on their website for pizzas was outrageous. Magdalena's was only 20 minutes from my destination of the Hard Rock and it was certainly worth it. A very good pizza overall and cooked well. Staff was nice and the place was rather quaint and comfy. When I come back next week I may stop in again
I ordered 2 Lamb Biryani, when I got home, the meat is beef not lamb! I paid $36 for beef! When I called, the guy said it's lamb and hung up on me!!!! Seriously! I will never order from here again!

Went through the drive threw and ordered a strawberry banana smoothie, large fries and an unsweetened ice tea. they gave me a smoothie that was about 3/4 full with full chunks of frozen strawberry and sweetened ice tea. I'd avoid this mcdonald's at ALL costs and I plan on never returning. Someone should get their workers to actually do their jobs
Maybe I just love chicken salad, but this place tickled my fancy. And of course the tea was sweeeeet

Bad service.  A group of 8 of us got together for a girls night.  Lana barely came over to us to check about anything.    As I'm pregnant, I asked if any of the drinks were available as mocktails.  She said no, they didn't do any of those.  My only options were soda, tea, or lemonade.  The gluten free and also pregnant member of our group only had an option if a salad.  The food took forever.  Lana never brought any refills.  I won't be going back.  The bathrooms were also disgusting this night.  The only nice thing was a woman named Christy who checked on us and took out pictures.

meh. i was enticed by their social media. the ambiance of the restaurant looked like it was designed on a budget. the food came out super quick and our server was a total doll!!! the macaroni and cheese was not worth more than $8. it's overpriced and not tasty after the first 4 bites
Not fantastic... the hostess was wonderful but the food and overall service was just ok... there are many better choices...
Had a great bowl the other day. It was açaí with berries and bananas and seeds. Just super good. Ready very fast. The staff were all so friendly and upbeat. Thank you all!! You're doing great.

Food is very good. I ordered the shrimp and grits, it was above average. Not the best Ive had in NOLA but very good. Wife had the banana fosters french toast, it was also very good.
Put yourself on the waitlist prior to coming. The lines here get ridiculous and the waits can be very long.
Overall it is worth visiting if you are in NOLA. I would come back.
WORSE CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER! Do not come here! They do not try to please there customers at all! If I could give no stars I would!

Ruined my valentines day. If I can save one person with this review then my life is complete. Do not go see this poorly organized show. Just stay home watch TV and have sex like self respecting people do.

Got their salt and pepper pork chops and their beef fried rice for takeout. Fried rice portions were extremely generous. Rice had enough flavor and pork chops were standard. Curious to see what other canto dishes they offer!

Apparently this is sweet mango habanero! And I even ordered the sauce on the side but where is it? If I had wanted just plain mediocre wings I would've fried some myself instead of pay 6.99 for some shit wing dings. And the guy on the phone had the audacity to hang up on me

Wow!!! This poke is amazing!!! Everything is SO fresh,  the portions are gigantic (especially the fish) - this is one of the best values for a healthy lunch or dinner in all of Brentwood. Perfect for take out/pick-up after work for dinner. The build your own bowl is my favorite - so many fresh toppings, toppings and more toppings and then there are the sauces, and also a ton of gluten free options! The people who work here are so really nice and friendly - that is always a plus. I cannot recommend this place enough!

Quaint dining setting perfect for a night out close to the beach. If this wasn't the best Pad Thai I've ever had, it's definitely a tie for my favorite with a place in another state. Hard to find Pad Thai this good. Also thought the veggie spring rolls and fresh rolls were very tasty. Thoroughly enjoyed dinner. High recommend!

It's a real treat to go out to dinner after having restaurants closed for so long. We went to Land Ocean for our anniversary. They are seating patrons at every other table. The hostess was friendly and greeted us as we arrived. Unfortunately there wasn't enough room at the bar with the limited seating to have a pre-dinner drink but they got our table ready early. Coconut shrimp was decent, large prawns, dipping sauce was standard sweet coconut dip. They were average and so was the artichoke. No complaints! The teriyaki wagyu sirloin was FANTASTIC. Cooked to perfection at medium rare. Very very good. I would go back for the wagyu for sure. And it was priced right at 29 dollars for surf and turf, great deal in my opinion. My wife got the filet stir fry and it was pretty much what you would expect. Spicier than I thought it would have been. Overall, great service, nice atmosphere and the food was good.

Customer service was excellent, very attentive, and very friendly - S/O to Ginny!! Space was very clean and followed safety guidelines. The menu had such variety and ranged from Japanese food to Viet food! Food was bomb. King Wok never slips, support your local businesses!!

Despite some of the sub par reviews, we decided to give La Provence a shot, and I'm glad we did. Our server was excellent (possibly Nate?). He was busy but that did not affect our experience. He gauged the guests expectations very well and matched his pace with each of them seamlessly. The food was perfectly prepared. Fish was not dry and the courses came out at the perfect time. I will certainly be back.

My hubby took me out for my birthday and I couldn't be more impressed with everything. The portions of food for the price. The ambiance, the Italian singers in the background. I ordered the butternut pasta dish soooooo good! My husband order shrimp scampi and was very shocked to count 8 jumbo prawns in his dish. Normally he get 5-6 at other restaurants we have been to for that same order. When it was time for dessert, the waiter had been told it was my birthday so he came by with a plate of goodies and had me pick one. I chose the tiramisu. On point! A man sung me happy birthday in italian and my tiramisu had a candle in it. Overall experience was awesome, staff was extremely friendly!!!! Way better than my experiences in the past at olive garden. A++++ I am one happy customer.

Love, love the Ale House, and can't beat that it's only 4 minutes away!  My husband and I tried the corn beef Rubin and I the Corn Beef Egg Roll only a dollar difference in the two.  Must say the Rubin Sandwich was delicious and came with fries.  The Egg Rolls where not worth $10 , very small, over fried and almost to tough to chew. I was very disappointed in the Egg Roll and would not recommend it.

Jam Bong is my favorite soup to date and it's flawless from Korea Garden. It's very spicy without sacrificing flavor and the seafood is always fresh and plentiful, in fact the serving size is enough for two but you won't want to share. I always order this when I'm not feeling well or to warm up on a cold winters day. The service is relaxed so it's not a place to dine in if you're in a time crunch.

We've been to this restaurants three times now.
The first two times we were thrilled. Food was great!
We had the smoked ricotta for starter and beef and lamb for main the first time and dumplings, beef and swordfish  and for dessert the apple pie the second time - fish tasted a little too fishy for my taste but the served sides and sauces were always great and the starters and dessert were great!
The third time we had the tartar for starter and the New York beef and the stroganoff - both on the special menu. This time it was a little disappointing. Food was still good but nothing really special and too pricey for the taste we've gotten. Even tho the place was not packed the girl at the desk wanted to squeeze us in on a table between 6 other busy tables. After I asked for another table, since I am pregnant and need a little more space, the girl reseated us with a bad attitude.

The place is nice for dinner but pricey. We've always paid over 100$ for two. Still recommend to try it out, because of the fine taste of the dishes.

For a place that is near the mall near my work and away from the water, I am impressed with the variety and quality of options.  My dinner was the shrimp stuffed with crab to perfection.  I barely missed happy hour, but my friends got there early and ordered an awesome octopus appetizer that i tried.  The service really makes this a 5 star rating in my opinion!

Best fancy restaurant in Pima county IMHO. Especially if you like authentic italian food. Not too expensive yet an amazing experience.
Best time to come is Saturday and/or Sunday nights/evenings when they have live un-intrusive guitar playing outside. Worried about cold, sun, or rain? No worries it's shaded patio with heaters.

We know italian food, have lived back east, and aren't shy around seafood (something that's hard to find here in Tucson, and no sushi doesn't count!)

There's a particular waitress there who's the absolute best waitress i've ever had outside of fine dining. Her smile is full of warmth and she makes you feel cared for. Though this is sort of fine dining and there is always a chef making your food.

It's quiet, can dine indoors if you'd like, the nearby shops are nice,...Tucson's best kept secret.
No intrusive car noise either, especially towards night time.

Way better than La Encantada or any place over in the Catalina Foothills other than the resorts. Better than most places downtown too imho.

It's difficult to find good italian food in tucson, good service, good food, reasonably priced, quiet place, live music without being intrusive,...all in one.

I swear, this is the only fancy restaurant in Tucson that is well-run, meets my standards, while not over-charging.

Oh and there's: plenty of parking, safe neighborhood, good warm outdoor lighting without being intrusive,...

I had my birthday here too in the Spring and loved it.

Ive only gone here dur

The rice and tomato-cucumber salad tasted amazing. I also ordered the chicken gyro and it was ok. Very busy cafe so parking and seating were sparse but to me that just indicates the food must be good. Would definitely return and try some of their other dishes!

Saw this place driving and decided to stop in. Best burger I've had. I had the Ghost burger, not sure if intentional but there was a sheet of paper left between the patty and bottom bun. I did order this pickup and it kept the bottom bun from getting soggy on drive home

Our family loves Garden Grille Café.  The breakfast is very good.  Before Covid it was a great place to meet up with family or friends because we love the atmosphere.  We loved going in for dinner as well.  The best part is that breakfast is served all day!  We did not want this restaurant to feel the pressures of 2020 so we have gotten take out several times.  Even for my birthday that was yesterday.  My husband kept asking me where I wanted to eat and all I was craving was the Key West Shrimp Pasta.  It's consistently delicious and always served hot even when taking it home.  My husband loves the steak tips with noodles and mushrooms.  Keep up the great work Garden Grill and we will keep supporting you through this unprecedented time.

Cole's Kitchen... formally adored as Green Hills staple, FireFly... was possibly one of the worst experiences I have had in Nashville. We opted to sit outside in the cold rain because it felt like waiting for death inside. For the food... the chicken was moist and that's about all you can say. How you mess up collards and corn pudding is beyond me. Your average Chinese take out makes better Soba noodles. We sat outside and another party was celebrating their engagement. We offered to send a glass of champagne to each of the family of 11. The waitress of both our tables returns with 3 bottles of Vueve and charged us $160 a bottle. We were drinking $8 glasses at the time. I was also charged for two drinks I didn't have but at that rate I was so ready to leave I paid my over charged bill and promised myself I would never return. It would have been over priced and a mediocre meal before but adding an extra $480 to the bill because they knew we wouldn't realize that the family celebrating hadn't ordered themselves drinks of their own. I felt taken advantage of and do not appreciate the waitress taking it upon herself to upgrade the drinks with zero communication.
The seafood is great but don't get the strawberry cake. Awful. Dry and tasted old. We couldn't eat it. And they charge for butter and cocktail sauce.
Veal Marsala excellent....tender flavorful and generous portions,came with roasted potatoes and zucchini

Came here for my Prom night dinner. We made a reservation and were immediately seated. Service was quick and friendly. Food was great! I recommend if you have any special occasion or fancy date night.

Got a 16" (medium) half Don, half chicken. 
It's was pretty good, but for $38.98 for a single pizza I expect to have my mind blown.

First time at this original location and am so glad we stopped in for some amazing takeout! Great portions, full of flavor, made with care. Mole is wonderful - not like what most Tucson restaurants call mole in my experience - this one is rich and chocolatey with just the right amount of spice. Chili rellenos is also a good choice. 
The restaurant is clean and the to go portions are more than enough. Ask Danielle what she recommends - she provides a welcoming smile and conversation as well as a thorough knowledge of the menu.
I've read that they are cash only, but today I was able to pay via credit card.

Biked up to East falls on a pleasant Saturday. Thought this would be a good pit stop. Outdoor seating was readily available, and their Covid-friendly ordering & pick up process was easy to understand. However, we had to wait more than 45 minutes for a waffle and two lattes. And when we finally got the waffle, it was room temperature. The iced lattes were ok. 

Don't know if they were short staffed, but two tables around us had been waiting for more than an hour. One table left without their food after waiting for almost two hours. I think the restaurant was prioritizing grub hub orders over in-person dining. Will not be back soon.
The service was terrible, terrible. The waiter doesn't know how to smile and say thank you.
Had some pasta entrees for take out. They weren't bad but nothing special. Their fresh bread was good and if I were to go back I'd try a pizza.

This place is amazing. Since it opened up we have been stopping by and they never disappoint. Great owners, very friendly and great food. When friends and family ask for a recommendation for somewhere on our side of town, SSS is where I direct them.

We ordered delivery from Manee and Grubhub. Spring rolls were crispy and great. I didn't like the papaya salad- it's not like the ones we've had else were! It wasn't sweet, tart- very muted flavors. The pad Thai and drunken noodles were awesome though! I love how you can set the spicy level for each dish! I got level 3 and could've gone up- but great heat but not over powering. The pork was cooked really well- not overdone. Very excited for the leftovers!

Cute place with a fun atmosphere. It was bustling when we stopped in after dinner for some dessert. My sister and I shared the james brownie sundae and I wish I had taken a pic of it! It wasn't in a sundae bowl, it came out in a tall cup and it was covered in chocolate syrup. Just wasn't what we were expecting but still delicious. Strawberry cheesecake ice cream was good too but nothing amazing. Next then I'd try some of their unique flavors

AMAZING CHICKEN SHAWERMA. Juicy, seasoned, just right! They are flexible and will let you get combo bowls, and to get multiple servings of toppings.

Be sure to go to the second floor! Very cute place to sit.

They also gave us basbousa and falafel on the house along with everyone else who was sitting there! So nice!
This is my spot pre COVID. The biscuits are so good here. Great price Great service great taste

We got carryout Diavola this week to help support one of our favorite local restaurants, and the service was quick and food was delicious! Not to mention, still have wine for carryout! The Burrata and Macellaio pizza were fantastic. Thank you for staying open!
Huge portions and great service. I could make this post long, but let me tell you, the food was great, and my belly was full... will be back

My wife and I started coming here approximately 3 months ago to get drinks as we were not hungry because we had eaten earlier in the day. The owner was super nice and said we should come and try lunch some time, the following weekend we did. We are so glad we did and have been coming back regularly since because it is always fresh and the owner is so cool and friendly. I drive thru when ever I have time on my way to work also for the great coffee and friendly staff and of course the owner is always around to say hi and thank you for coming. 
So the food is FANTASTIC and a great Tucson spot for breakfasts, lunch, coffee and dinner anytime. Keep up the greatness.

The new Washington Avenue location is even better than the old Central West End location! The street corn is amazing and they should put it on everything. It is attached to a hotel and right next to the convention center so the move was probably the right decision business-wise. I wish them all the luck in the future.
Good food.   Slow service.  No explanation given.   Pricey for the quality.   Still one of the best around.

Their dishes are just so savory and delicious. I would highly recommend the Red Curry, especially the night I came in, there was a lil' rain outside so it was even tastier. The Pad Thai and Salad were good too with a hint of sweetness. The waiter and waitress were friendly, especially Lisa. Warm decor and lighting inside makes it more Thai authentic!

I absolutely love Twenty Two Juicery & Smoothie Bar. I went for the first time and I was blown away by how good my smoothie and juice tasted. The best part is the prices, everything was so affordable. I love how you can see them use every fresh ingredient. I definitely recommend visiting if you are looking for a fresh yummy juice or smoothie!

I ordered the hot and crunchy with the chargrilled steak over sticky rice. The combo bowl is outstanding. I saw Chef Sherrick prepare the bowl with ingredients that make it absolutely delicious. The steak is tender and flavorful, the jicama, green onion and more combine with a perfect guacamole topped over sticky rice with a tantalizing sauce and fried thin onions. Could not wait to get home and eat it. I have a selection of eight more combo  bowls to go, I think. The dining room is modern and comfortable with outdoor seating , fair prices, wine and beer, and friendly and accommodating staff. Say hello to the Chef. You might just get an extra dollop of guacamole.

Stopped by for lunch. Sat outside on their beautiful patio. Eva was our server.  She could not have been nicer. She recommended the Fontana burger.  It was absolutely delightful and perfect. . The fries were delicious and fresh. 

The service Eva provided was a 10/10 and made part of experience perfect.  Fun, positive, and uplifting even during a pandemic. 

Food quality was excellent.  Fries fresh and crispy.  Burger seasoned perfectly.  Amazing taste.  Side salad was pleasantly large and croutons were delicious. I know, how does a crouton stand out but theirs do. 

Can't wait to go back.

I'm so glad we made a reservation for dinner. The food was amazing! The ambience was superb and so was the food! Would have gave 5 stars but the service was a little slow. It was very busy might I add so I always take that into consideration but still service was not the best.

Devon Seafood Grill is a great place for a nice and fancy seafood dinner. Located in Rittenhouse Square, the restaurant provides a great lively atmosphere with a view of the park. I came here for my girlfriend's birthday, and we both had an amazing experience! 

They offer both indoor and outdoor seating, and I highly recommend making a reservation, as they are usually fully booked on the weekend. Our server, Devon was great! He was friendly and helpful, and helped me get a candle on the creme brulee for my girlfriend's birthday!

The food was delicious!! We got the shrimp gumbo and calamari to share for starters, and they were both seasoned to perfection. The calamari comes with both head pieces and the tentacles, which were both so yummy! They also come out with some great buttery biscuits that are complementary for everyone and so delicious. 

For the main course, she got the crab cakes and I got the seafood mixed grill, which includes salmon, 2 scallops, 4 shrimps, and a crab cake. I loved having a great variety of food to choose from! The scallops and crab cakes were probably my favorite, but I'd suggest that anyone new here try this to get a sense of all the seafood available. Dessert was a perfectly made creme brulee that tasted great!

My only critique is that service can be slow because of how understaffed they are. It seems like management did not hire enough staff to support the number of people eating. Otherwise, our experience was definitely a great one!
